subtopics.label: Immune Checkpoint Inhibitor Clinical Outcomes in Advanced Melanoma
subtopics.description: Clinical trials and real-world analyses evaluating efficacy, long-term survival, toxicity, and retreatment strategies for PD-1, CTLA-4, and combination checkpoint inhibitor therapies in advanced melanoma patients.
subtopics.short_description: Efficacy, survival, toxicity, and retreatment strategies for PD-1, CTLA-4, and combination checkpoint inhibitors in advanced melanoma.

subtopics.label: BRAF/MEK Targeted Therapy in Melanoma
subtopics.description: Studies examining BRAF and MEK inhibitor therapies (dabrafenib, trametinib) in BRAF-mutant melanoma, including long-term outcomes, combination strategies, and resistance mechanisms.
subtopics.short_description: BRAF and MEK inhibitor outcomes, combination strategies, and resistance mechanisms in BRAF-mutant melanoma.

subtopics.label: Tumor-Infiltrating Lymphocytes and Melanoma Immune Microenvironment
subtopics.description: Research characterizing tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte states, differentiation trajectories, and functional properties within the melanoma tumor microenvironment and their prognostic significance.
subtopics.short_description: TIL states, differentiation trajectories, and functional properties within the melanoma immune microenvironment.

subtopics.label: CAR T Cell and Adoptive Immunotherapy for Melanoma
subtopics.description: Preclinical and translational studies developing CAR T cell therapies and adoptive T cell transfer strategies targeting melanoma-specific antigens such as TYRP1 and MART-1.
subtopics.short_description: Preclinical and translational development of CAR T cell and adoptive T cell therapies targeting melanoma-specific antigens.

subtopics.label: Molecular Biology and Metastatic Mechanisms in Melanoma
subtopics.description: Investigations into molecular pathways, epigenetic regulators, and cellular mechanisms driving melanoma progression, metastasis, and resistance to oxidative stress, including PRC1 loss and tRNA methylation.
subtopics.short_description: Epigenetic regulators and cellular mechanisms driving melanoma progression, metastasis, and oxidative stress resistance.

subtopics.label: Cutaneous T-Cell Lymphoma and Lymphoproliferative Disorders
subtopics.description: Clinical and histopathological studies of cutaneous lymphomas including mycosis fungoides, lymphomatoid papulosis, and CD4+ small/medium T-cell lymphoproliferative disorders, covering diagnosis, treatment, and outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Diagnosis, treatment, and outcomes for mycosis fungoides, lymphomatoid papulosis, and related cutaneous lymphomas.

subtopics.label: Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma in Immunocompromised Patients
subtopics.description: Studies examining the impact of immunosuppression—including solid organ transplantation and other immunomodulating conditions—on the prognosis, metastasis, and management of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.
subtopics.display_name: Squamous Cell Carcinoma in Immunocompromised Patients
subtopics.short_description: Impact of transplantation and immunosuppression on prognosis, metastasis, and management of cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma.

subtopics.label: Surgical Management and Reconstruction of Skin Cancer Defects
subtopics.description: Clinical studies evaluating surgical techniques for reconstruction of cutaneous defects following skin cancer resection, including scalp reconstruction with dermal templates and keystone advancement flaps.
subtopics.display_name: Surgical Reconstruction of Skin Cancer Defects
subtopics.short_description: Techniques for reconstructing cutaneous defects after skin cancer resection, including dermal templates and advancement flaps.

subtopics.label: Melanoma Epidemiology, Racial Disparities, and Patient-Reported Outcomes
subtopics.description: Population-level analyses and patient-centered research examining racial disparities in melanoma survival, staging accuracy in acral melanoma, and health-related quality of life in melanoma patients.
subtopics.short_description: Racial disparities in survival, staging accuracy in acral melanoma, and health-related quality of life in melanoma patients.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence and Imaging for Skin Lesion Detection
subtopics.description: Development and evaluation of deep learning and machine learning models for automated classification and early detection of skin lesions including melanoma.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning and machine learning models for automated classification and early detection of melanoma and skin lesions.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Tumor DNA Monitoring in Melanoma
subtopics.description: Studies developing and applying ctDNA and cell-free DNA technologies for ultrasensitive tumor burden monitoring, minimal residual disease detection, and treatment response assessment in melanoma and solid tumors.
subtopics.short_description: ctDNA and cell-free DNA technologies for tumor burden monitoring, minimal residual disease detection, and treatment response assessment.

subtopics.label: Combination Immunotherapy Strategies and Preclinical Tumor Models
subtopics.description: Preclinical studies investigating combination approaches to enhance antitumor immunity, including TGFβ inhibition, LDH inhibition, phosphatidylserine targeting, GITR engagement, and cyclophosphamide-based regimens in melanoma and solid tumor models.
subtopics.short_description: Preclinical combination strategies enhancing antitumor immunity, including TGFβ inhibition, GITR engagement, and phosphatidylserine targeting.
